caption: The drawing features two separate images of intricately decorated mugs, each one presented on a cream-colored background. Both mugs are colored in shades of brown, giving the appearance of dark glazed pottery or wood, with lighter highlights to suggest gloss and texture. The upper mug displays a relief scene of a single male figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat, surrounded by bunches of grapes and grape leaves. The handle of the mug is also ornately sculpted, blending into the detailed vegetal motif that extends around the mug’s surface. The lower mug is similarly colored and styled, but shows two figures: one male, also in a wide-brimmed hat, and one female wearing a bonnet or scarf, both surrounded by a similar motif of grapes and vine leaves. The relief patterns are emphasized with lighter coloring to highlight the raised areas. Both drawings focus on the side view of each mug, showing the full handle on the left in the top image and on the right in the bottom image. The composition allows for examination of both the shape and the decorative details.
title: Toby Mug Set (2 pieces)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
